_note: Curated code recipes for catalogue substitute edges, written by hand for Bharat Sourcer on 2026-10-09. Each recipe implements the `code` changes of one edge in data/parts_catalog.json for the named library only; other changes stay notes. Recipes are deterministic text edits applied outside comments and strings; a required step that matches nothing, or more than max_matches places, refuses the whole recipe instead of guessing. A curated patch is not compiled or tested on hardware.

recipes.library: Adafruit DHT sensor library or DHTesp

steps.describe: Sensor type DHT22 → DHT11 (DHTTYPE define, constructor or DHTesp setup)

implements: Swap Adafruit_SSD1306 for Adafruit_SH110X: Adafruit_SH1106G display(128, 64, &Wire, -1); display.begin(0x3C, true); SSD1306_WHITE becomes SH110X_WHITE. Drawing calls (Adafruit GFX) are unchanged.

steps.describe: Display object Adafruit_SSD1306 → Adafruit_SH1106G (same width, height, Wire and reset arguments)
PlatformIO / library dependency Adafruit SSD1306 → Adafruit SH110X

implements: STEP high and low must each last at least 1.9 µs: call stepper.setMinPulseWidth(2) (AccelStepper) and check delayMicroseconds(1) loops.
not_implemented: Microstep tables differ (up to 1/32); update steps per mm.

steps.insert: {indent}{var}.setMinPulseWidth(2);  // DRV8825: STEP pulses of at least 1.9 µs
steps.describe: Call setMinPulseWidth(2) after each stepper's setMaxSpeed()

recipes.no_code_change: STEP/DIR code is unchanged for this substitute; check the motor direction on first run because some modules invert DIR.
